Defaults for the sharpen skill — the SHARPEN half of delegation-loop.md's elicitation demarcation. brief_filename_pattern is the naming pattern for the ONLY write target above; it carries a FULL date, not YYYY-MM, so two sessions on the same topic in one month cannot collide. delegation_loop_standard is NORMATIVE and read live: § Elicitation demarcation defines the two question classes, the OUTCOME-line routing test, the both-directions guard this skill's refusal rule enforces, and the ORIGIN-freshness clause; § v3 defines the lineage rule and the four ORIGIN forms a CHART cites a ratified brief through.
